title: Patch: `permanents_on_field` meets a card lying on a unit zone after its side's backrow
notes: R4665000: query::permanents_on_field and reachable_permanents_on_field (plague placements, random field exiles, the Radiant-field pool, anomaly copies) meet a card lying on a unit zone (S #9 Ticketed stacked on a Unit) after that side's backrow lanes, as the walks #4760 fixed do; a board with no lying card lists as before. Engine change; the catalog is untouched, so the card is claimed with --plays. Classify stage 2 against the merge base's build finds classic-076 (Plague Bringer, whose placement prompt lists every permanent) plays differently, and no rule. No KEPT_SCRIPTS entry: no script changed; replays it alters are refused as rules_changed (R767000).

player.title: Ticketed on a Unit is met after the backrow
fixes: Random effects over every permanent, and the choice of where a Plague Counter goes, now meet a Ticketed stacked on a Unit after that side's backrow cards, as other such effects do.
